summary: An acid bass line firmware: write a 16-step pattern or roll a random one, then shape it with knobs modelled on a TD-3-MO and Devil Fish style panel. Can sync with sibling firmwares over Bluetooth.
features: 16-step patterns with accent and slide; LFO button rolls a random pattern
Seven knob pages incl. Devil Fish-style drive, tracking, filter FM
16 patterns per project, chains of up to 16; 12 projects
Hold-to-play punch-in FX pads, eight shared with Chipbox and Drumlab
'Brothers Link' Bluetooth sync of tempo, patterns, key and sidechain
No drums; a bass line instrument only
